7 Days / 6 Nights

Kashmir Great Lakes Trek

Srinagar — Sonamarg — Nichnai — Vishansar Lake — Gadsar Lake — Zaj Pass — Satsar Lake — Gangabal Lake — Naranag — Srinagar

About This Trip

Awara Banjara brings you the iconic Kashmir Great Lakes Trek—a thrilling 7-day high-altitude trekking expedition starting from Srinagar. Traverse through lush alpine meadows, cross high mountain passes like Nichnai and Gadsar, and witness turquoise alpine lakes including Vishansar, Gadsar, Satsar, and Gangabal at the foot of Mount Harmukh with expert guides and safety equipment.

Itinerary

Drive from Srinagar to Sonamarg (9,186 ft) and begin the 12 km trek to Nichnai (11,500 ft) taking approx 5–6 hours.

Trek through alpine meadows and cross Nichnai Pass to reach the stunning Vishansar Lake.

Pass by Kishansar Lake and cross Gadsar Pass (the highest point of the trek) to descend to Gadsar Lake.

Trek through rugged terrains and cross Zaj Pass to reach the collection of seven lakes at Satsar.

Descend towards the twin lakes of Gangabal and Nundkol lying at the foot of Mount Harmukh.

Final descent through pine forests from Gangabal Lake down to Naranag village.

Drive back from Naranag to Srinagar, concluding the trek.
